example_cases_3_2.title: The Old Tells Are Disappearing
example_cases_3_2.usage: Section 'Why Your Eyes Are Not Enough', item 1 (WaterfallFeatures)

environment_variables.SCENE_CONTENT: A side-by-side concept of outdated manual video-spotting advice losing relevance next to a modern AI video detection interface, rendered softly with no harsh lines.
environment_variables.UI_COMPONENTS: Two floating cards. Left: a slightly transparent, desaturated card titled 'Manual Checklist' with three struck-through line items reading exactly 'Count the fingers', 'Check the shadows', 'Look for waxy skin', each paired with a tiny minimalist icon (a hand, a light bulb, a face). Right: a crisp pristine white card titled 'AI Video Detector' with six stacked signal rows whose labels read exactly 'Visual Artifact Analysis', 'Temporal Coherence', 'AI Watermark Scan', 'Content Provenance', 'Facial Authenticity', 'File Forensics', each row with a small icon and a rounded status dot. Render every quoted label verbatim. Do not invent any other metric names. Never use text-analysis terms such as perplexity, burstiness, linguistic naturalness, or writing style. No percentage scores.
environment_variables.LIME_ACCENT_TARGET: Only the small round status dots on the right-hand detector card.
environment_variables.AI_SYMBOL_PLACEMENT: One borderless electric lime stepped-cross floating in the negative space between the two cards, hinting the shift from manual to AI-assisted checking.

example_cases_3_2.title: Temporal Variance Gap
example_cases_3_2.usage: Section 'Why Your Eyes Are Not Enough', item 2 (WaterfallFeatures)

environment_variables.SCENE_CONTENT: A clean, inviting motion-variance line chart comparing real handheld camera footage against AI-generated video, the core data story of the page.
environment_variables.UI_COMPONENTS: One large pristine white card containing a soft line chart with a thin dotted grey grid. Two curves: a gently jagged charcoal grey line (handheld camera) and a nearly flat line far below it (AI video). Two small rounded legend pills sit in the top corner of the card.
environment_variables.LIME_ACCENT_TARGET: Only the flat AI-video line and a tiny rounded anomaly-flag pill attached to its end.
environment_variables.AI_SYMBOL_PLACEMENT: A small stepped-cross resting right at the end of the flat lime line, marking the algorithmic finding.
